entries.reason: The constant-one circuit C_top accepts every satisfiable formula. Therefore no list containing only satisfiable formulas can force a false negative from every polynomial-size candidate circuit. H112's universal arbitrary-circuit quantifier is false independently of how the list is constructed.
salvage: H116 restricts the quantified circuits to circuits sound for SAT.
A valid arbitrary-circuit anti-checker must restore certified negative examples or prove a soundness-enforcing normalization.

entries.reason: For the constant-one circuit there exists no satisfiable formula F with C_top(F)=0. Hence no universal decoder can force the false-negative polarity promised by H113 for every candidate circuit, regardless of the range-avoidance output.
salvage: A future decoder may work under an explicit SAT-soundness promise.
Alternatively it must allow false-positive outputs with independently checkable UNSAT certificates.
